title: RAYLEIGH GUIDE STAR FOR ADAPTIVE OPTICS IN OPTICAL COMMUNICATIONS (ARTES 4.0 SL SPL 6C.075) EXPRO+
description: Objective: The objective of the activity is to evaluate the use of a Rayleigh guide star as a reference beacon for adaptive opticspre-and post-compensation for optical communication through the atmosphere.Targeted Improvements:75% reduction in cost and complexity with respect to the use of a Sodium guide star laserDescription:The use of a Rayleigh guide star as a reference beacon for optical pre-and post-compensation over the current Sodium laser solution would allow for a considerable decrease in both the cost and complexity of the laser system required for adaptive optics in optical links through the atmosphere.The Rayleigh guide star shall be evaluated for its suitability and be compared to existing solutions, to demonstrate the potential improvements. An evaluation of the sub-system, the choice of equipment and the operational implementation shall be addressed for use on optical communication links through the atmosphere. The activity will perform a numerical study comparing the main possible beacons to be used as reference for pre- and post-compensation in Adaptive Optics (AO) in the context of optical communications, using as a reference the 3 main solutions: Sodium Guide Star, Beacon from the satellite and Rayleigh Guide Star. A selection of suitable equipment solutions will need to be chosen and the impact of the beacon method on the global architecture/cost, ease of operation/complexity/laser safety of backscattered light evaluated. Upon a positive solution being proposed, integration and tests will be conducted in a laboratory environment, and then on-sky tests will be conducted.

title: END-TO-END MODELLING OF THE RADIATION HARDNESS ASSURANCE PROCESS - EXPRO+
description: Objectives: To develop an integrated software toolkit to assess the relative contributions to overall errors and uncertainties in the radiation hardness assurance process and estimate the true risk of failures. Description: The current process for Radiation Hardness Assurance (RHA) attempts to ensure compliance to mission robustness, reliability and availability with respect to radiation. This includes a range of measures addressed at different stages of the process. environment models are often applied with confidence levels and margins which in isolation may not sufficiently mitigate risk, the transport of radiation through shielding can incorporatea great deal of hidden margin (depending on the level of detail of the radiation model) but this can also be reduced to near-zero through detailed analysis and effects in components based on test data are highly susceptible to component specifics combined with other degradation parameters and temperature variations. Given this myriad of factors the true risk of component failure is not easy to discern. This activity shall address Radiation Hardness Assurance (RHA) as an integrated approach from radiation environment modelling to component acceptance to determine true risk levels for the end-to-end process. This shall include assessment of the probabilities of component failure for various environments using different methods for capturing environmental variability, radiation model fidelity and uncertainties in component test data and related statistical approaches. This shall be able to incorporate a digital representation of the spacecraft for radiation transport, test data for components and a range of orbital environments thereby spanning multiple disciplines in spacecraft design and quality assurance and extracting benefits from adopting a Model-Based System Engineering (MBSE) approach. The system shall incorporate estimates of errors and uncertainties at each step of the process to derivean estimate of the true risk of failure. This activity shall encompass the following tasks: - Investigate the requirements and definition of process by consultation with radiation experts in industry as well as at ESA - Establish the use cases and collect relevant radiation effects data to test in the software; - Design of the software architecture leveraging existing assets to link orbits, environments, propagation and effects; - Develop algorithms to propagate uncertainties through the different steps of the RHA process;- Derivation of "true risk" estimates and comparison with current approaches; - Make recommendations for the maturation of this integrated (MBSE) approach Software shall be delivered under an ESA Software Community Licence.Procurement Policy: C(2) = A relevant participation (in terms of quality and quantity) of non-primes (incl. SMEs) is required. For additional information please go to:http://www.esa.int/About_Us/Business_with_ESA/Small_and_Medium_Sized_Enterprises/Opportunities_forSMEs/Procurement_policy_on_fair_access_for_SMEs_-_the_C1-C4_Clauses

title: Analyse und Gestaltung des programmatischen Umfelds für den Schutz von Weltraumsystemen (QA901)
description: Die zivile und militärische Nutzung von Weltraumsystemen steigt weiter an. Vor dem Hintergrund jüngster Weltraumsicherheitsereignisse sowie aktueller und zukünftiger Konflikte gewinnt der Schutz von Weltraumsystemen eine besondere Bedeutung. Die Studie soll die vorhandenen nationalen und internationalen Initiativen und Projekte im Bereich "Schutz von Weltraumsystemen" analysieren und deren Mehrwert im Hinblick auf eine mögliche deutsche Beteiligung bewerten. Auf dieser Grundlage soll ein Vorschlag für einen nationalen Handlungsrahmen für notwendige Aktivitäten zum Schutz der eigenen Weltraumsysteme erarbeitet werden. Siehe Leistungsbeschreibung. title: OSP - aanpassingswerken gebouw & installatie (labo-)technieken
description: De Vlaamse Instelling voor Technologisch Onderzoek (VITO) heeft, als strategisch onderzoekscentrum, de opdracht om volop in te zetten op wateronderzoek en –innovatie, vanuit West-Vlaanderen. Voor de verdere uitbouw van deze onderzoeksactiviteiten, heeft VITO een overeenkomst afgesloten met GEOxyz. Zo worden enerzijds instapklare kantoren gebouwd, en daarnaast een casco piloothal. Deze opdracht omvat de uitbouw van deze casco hal naar een multifunctionele water testhal, met bijhorende labo’s, opslagplaatsen en atelier. Onderstaande aanvraag betreft: 1/ de aanpassingen en wijzigingen aan de aangeleverde casco testhal (voorbereiding voor VITO uitrol), 2/ de verdere ruwbouwwerken en inrichting van de casco testhal naar de VITO-eisen (ready to use) en 3/ de technieken daartoe nodig (HVAC, gas, sanitair en elektriciteit) Met dit bestek nodigt de Aanbestedende Overheid de kandidaten uit om een offerte voor de opdracht in te dienen, mits zij voldoen aan de Uitsluitingsgronden en kwalitatieve selectie (zie I.8). title: „Осигуряване правото за ползване и поддържане на софтуерния пакет на ATDI SA, Франция“.
description: Обектът на обществената поръчка по смисъла на чл. 3, ал. 1, т. 3 от ЗОП е услуга. Предмет на обществената поръчка: Осигуряване правото за ползване и поддържане на софтуерния пакет на ATDI SA, Франция. Правно основание: Възложителят възлага настоящата обществена поръчка по реда на глава двадесет и шеста от ЗОП на основание чл. 191, ал. 1. т. 2 от ЗОП, във връзка с чл. 20, ал. 3, т. 2 от ЗОП. Място на изпълнение на поръчката: гр. София, КРС, ул. „Ген. Йосиф В. Гурко” № 6. Срок за изпълнение на поръчката: Към настоящия момент КРС има сключен договор за извънгаранционно поддържане и актуализация на функциониращия в КРС програмен пакет на ATDI SA, Франция, срокът на който изтича на 17.11.2024 г. Договорът по настоящата поръчка ще бъде сключен, считано от 18.11.2024 г. Срок на валидност на офертата: 4 (четири) месеца, считано от датата, определена като краен срок за получаване на офертата и представлява времето, през което Участникът е обвързан с условията в представената оферта. Възможност за представяне на варианти в офертата: Варианти на офертата няма да бъдат приемани от Възложителя. Прогнозна стойност на обществената поръчка е 73 000 (седемдесет и три хиляди) лева без включен ДДС. Посочената прогнозна стойност е максималният ресурс, с който Възложителят разполага. Изисквания към изпълнението на дейностите, предмет на поръчката: Предметът на поръчката включва дейности за осигуряване правото за ползване, поддържане и актуализация на специализиран програмен пакет, доставен и инсталиран за нуждите на КРС от френската фирма ATDI SA, предназначен за честотно планиране, оптимизация и управление на аналогови и цифрови радиомрежи от наземни и спътникови радиослужби. В предмета на поръчката се включва и закупуване на един допълнителен лиценз за модул HTZ Communications.
